article.headline: Red alert Delhi: heavy rain and 60 kmph winds batter capital
article.summary: The India Meteorological Department issued a red alert for all 11 Delhi districts on Monday due to heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, and intense winds.
article.body:
Up to 60 kmph gusts and rainfall exceeding 15 mm per hour arrived with a western disturbance, forcing the India Meteorological Department to place the capital under a red alert. While the downpour caused waterlogging near Jhandewalan Temple and left trees uprooted across the city, flight operations at the Delhi airport continued to function normally.

The intense weather provides a temporary break from recent warm conditions, with temperatures dropping by 1 to 2 degrees. Despite the immediate relief, the India Meteorological Department expects daytime temperatures to return to a range of 31 to 35 degrees Celsius over the coming days. Residents remain advised to anticipate potential traffic delays and avoid low-lying areas prone to flooding as the system continues to move through the region.

Beyond Delhi, an orange alert remains active for Faridabad, Gurugram, Rohtak, and Sonipat in Haryana, alongside nine districts in Uttar Pradesh. These areas face similar threats of lightning and winds gusting between 40 and 60 kmph. Commuters are urged to check traffic advisories before traveling and stay in contact with airlines for any potential scheduling updates resulting from the ongoing instability.

The India Meteorological Department reported that the current spell of rain is part of a wider trend impacting northern India, with forecasts of isolated to scattered rainfall extending across several other states including Rajasthan, Punjab, and Himachal Pradesh. The department continues to monitor the atmosphere for further developments regarding lightning and wind activity.

article.headline: J.J. McCarthy storms onto field for Giants debut in Washington clash
article.summary: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy made his New York Giants debut Sunday, recording five snaps and two carries during a 27-27 tie against the Washington Commanders.
article.body: J.J. McCarthy entered the game during the team’s first offensive possession in Washington, marking his first appearance for the Giants. His debut was brief and limited, as he ultimately recorded five total snaps throughout the Week 5 matchup. While his entry was intended to provide a shift in momentum, Washington appeared prepared for the personnel change. Reports indicate that each time McCarthy stepped onto the field, the defense anticipated a designed quarterback run or an RPO, holding him to just two yards on two carries. During one specific sequence, he attempted a pass to Darnell Mooney that resulted in a five-yard loss, though the team was bailed out by a facemask penalty.  For the Giants, integrating new personnel like McCarthy remains a tactical challenge as the team navigates a shifting rotation at the quarterback position. The use of backup signal-callers during high-stakes drives forces the coaching staff to balance offensive rhythm with the need to test new roster depth. Following the game, the team's snap count data revealed that the offense utilized 89 total plays in the overtime tie, with McCarthy seeing only a small fraction of the action.  The Giants ultimately fought back from a 14-point second-half deficit to secure a 27-27 tie at Northwest Stadium. Jameis Winston handled the bulk of the passing duties, finishing with 326 yards and three touchdowns, while the offense relied on heavy contributions from Malik Nabers and Isaiah Likely. The team moved to a 3-1-1 record after a late fumble by Cam Skattebo in overtime halted a potential game-winning drive. Despite the team's overall offensive production, McCarthy’s limited role did not yield significant yardage, leaving questions about how the backup will be utilized in future game plans as the season progresses.

article.headline: Mohamed Belloumi 74th-minute strike salvages draw for Hull against visiting Everton
article.summary: Hull City and Everton drew 2-2 at MKM Stadium as Mohamed Belloumi scored the equalizer in the second half.
article.body:
Substitute Mohamed Belloumi found the net in the 74th minute, turning a potential defeat into a hard-fought draw for the home side. The high-scoring second half saw the lead change hands twice after a scoreless opening period that included a disallowed goal by Everton's Brennan Johnson following a VAR check. 

The point maintains Hull City's unbeaten status at home since their return to the Premier League. For the visitors, the result serves as a reminder of their struggle to hold a lead, as they clawed back from an initial deficit only to concede the late equalizer. 

Joe Gelhardt opened the scoring for Hull in the 48th minute, capitalising on an error by Ainsley Maitland-Niles. Everton hit back swiftly when Maitland-Niles redeemed his earlier mistake by providing the assist for Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall to level with a header in the 55th minute. Thierno Barry, having missed multiple scoring opportunities earlier in the match, later put the visitors ahead by firing past Konstantinos Tzolakis. However, the lead was short-lived as Belloumi secured the final 2-2 scoreline. According to Sky Sports, the match concluded after a second half that featured all four goals scored in the contest. 

Both teams now head into the international break, with Hull City carrying their unbeaten home record forward and Everton left to reflect on the missed opportunity to secure all three points at the MKM Stadium.

article.headline: Sengkang MP Jamus Lim hospitalized with pneumonia after catching Influenza A
article.summary: Workers' Party MP Jamus Lim was admitted to hospital over the weekend after his blood oxygen level dropped to the low 90s following Influenza A that developed into pneumonia, forcing him to suspend his regular duties.
article.body:
A sniffle caught on camera in Parliament on Oct 6 escalated into a full hospital admission for Sengkang MP Jamus Lim. The second-term MP was seen pausing between sentences while speaking on the Finance Bill, wiping his nose as he spoke. Marine Parade-Braddell Heights MP Diana Pang walked over to hand him a tissue.

Lim's blood oxygen saturation fell to the low 90s over the weekend, well below the 95-100 range for healthy individuals, forcing hospitalization. In a Facebook post on Oct 12, Lim said the initial sniffle had developed into a bad case of Influenza A before culminating in full-blown pneumonia. He initially intended to take only the remainder of the week off work but checked into hospital as his condition worsened.

The MP is unable to attend his regular duties, including Monday's Meet-the-People Session and weekly house visits and estate walks. However, his TeamSengkang volunteers have agreed to step up and continue the Meet-the-People Session as usual. Lim said he will work from hospital to clear appeal letters and respond to email backlog.

Health Minister Ong Ye Kung said the rise in respiratory ailments stems from haze conditions coinciding with Influenza A season, compounding the problem. The Ministry of Health activated both the Public Health Preparedness Clinic scheme and the Haze Subsidy Scheme from Oct 12.

article.headline: New HDT Owner Kenny Habul Targets Iconic Reimagined Performance Cars in Bathurst
article.summary: Owner Kenny Habul has acquired the HDT Special Vehicles brand and plans to build a new performance car headquarters at Mount Panorama.
article.body:
Kenny Habul has officially taken the wheel at the Holden Dealer Team (HDT), acquiring the business from Peter Champion, who served as the brand's custodian for the past two decades. The move aims to prevent the iconic Australian marque from disappearing, with Habul pledging to inject new capital into the company and secure its future for upcoming generations. As a long-time collector of HDT vehicles, Habul intends to honor the legacy of racing legend Peter Brock by establishing a physical base at the spiritual home of Australian motorsport.

For enthusiasts and collectors, this acquisition signals a major shift toward factory-led restorations and modern performance developments. The business plan focuses on a 'restomod' approach, offering restoration services and new upgrade kits for existing classic models. This transition preserves a vital piece of motoring history that saw over 4,000 modified vehicles produced during the peak Brock era of the 1980s.

During an announcement in Bathurst, Habul revealed that development is already underway for a new performance vehicle. Prototypes are currently undergoing testing across three continents—Australia, Germany, and the USA. While specific details on the platform remain under wraps, Habul confirmed that a fundamental development recipe is being finalized. The long-term vision includes creating a dedicated facility in Bathurst, potentially housing a museum, a high-end workshop, and a showroom, should current negotiations with local authorities succeed.

This new chapter builds on the brand's storied history, which spanned from the iconic VK Commodore SS Group A to the retro-inspired VE and VF models. With production of the Holden Commodore now ended, the revived HDT aims to blend traditional manufacturing roots with global engineering standards to bring a new, reimagined performance car to the market.

article.summary: Kerry Kennedy releases a new memoir, Ethel Kennedy: The Extraordinary Life and Bold Legacy, which explores her mother's enduring resilience and family history.
article.body:
Ethel Kennedy spent a total of 99 months, or more than eight years, pregnant while raising her 11 children. Despite facing numerous public and private tragedies, Kerry Kennedy describes her mother as a woman who remained fully alive, chic, and devoid of self-reflection, famously noting that her mother hated the concept of introspection. 

This memoir matters because it provides an intimate look at the matriarch who helped define the Kennedy family name through decades of political and personal history. Beyond the family narrative, the book captures a partnership between Robert and Ethel Kennedy that was so significant it served as inspiration for the Taylor Swift song StarLight.

According to Kerry Kennedy, the project aims to honor her mother’s passion, philanthropy, and commitment to moving forward rather than dwelling on the past. In addition to the memoir, Kerry Kennedy has addressed current events, including the ongoing debate surrounding the preservation of the Kennedy Center in Washington, which she views as a vital memorial to a slain president. 

The book, titled Ethel Kennedy: The Extraordinary Life and Bold Legacy, arrives on Tuesday. It includes personal details, such as the family's transition from the compound in Hyannis Port to Hickory Hill, and reflects on the immense support Ethel provided to Robert Kennedy following the assassination of John F.
